arguments.prompt:
Probe how non-ASCII characters are encoded. Run this exact Python and report its full stdout verbatim:

s = "TESTSTART\u2014MIDDLE\u2019END\u2014café\u2026"

import unicodedata
print("nfkc:", unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", s).encode("utf-8"))
b = s.encode("utf-8")
